title: Quantum simulation of lattice gauge theories coupled to fermionic matter via anyonic regularization
summary: The optimal regularization of infinite-dimensional gauge-field degrees of freedom is a central open problem in the simulation of lattice gauge theories on quantum computers. Here, we consider regularizing the gauge field by replacing the gauge group $G$ with a braided fusion category whose objects correspond to Wilson lines of the associated Chern-Simons theory $G_k$, with the level $k$ serving as the regularization parameter.
